messages:
alex_support: Hey team, customer (Acme AI) reports their invoice is ~11.7% lower than the dashboard for their private VPC cluster. They sent a pdf and our dashboard shows 1.22M tokens for billing window, invoice shows 1.077M. Agent is on v1.4.3 in their VPC.

maria_infra: Noted. Any signs of dropped events or disk full on their agent host?

alex_support: Customer provided agent logs. I see a repeated pattern where heartbeats are coalesced into a single batch and then later a disk-flush error appears: 

alex_support: ```
2026-03-05T03:12:21Z agent: heartbeat coalesce window=5s aggregating=4
2026-03-05T03:12:26Z agent: flush buffer -> /var/lib/meter/buffer/part-7.err write=EIO
2026-03-05T03:12:26Z agent: buffer drop count=4 cause=flush_failure
```

sam_ops: Hmm. v1.4.3 has known issue where offline holdback + coalescing can lose count metadata if flush fails and retry path incorrectly advances seq pointers. We fixed in 1.4.5 (patch).

tony_support: Can you repro locally? Customer is urgent (billing dispute). We should provide a mitigation path + repro steps so they can confirm numbers.

maria_infra: Repro steps I used in a test env: start agent v1.4.3, enable `heartbeat_coalesce=true`, simulate disk EIO on flush (loopback mount + inject fault), send 6 heartbeats spaced to hit coalesce window. Run audit compare between agent ledger and collected meter. Example commands: 

maria_infra: ```bash
# start test agent
agent --config agent.test.yaml &
# simulate disk error (loses flush)
sudo dmsetup create faulty --table '0 2048000 error 0 0'
sudo mount /dev/mapper/faulty /var/lib/meter
# generate heartbeats
python tools/send_heartbeat.py --count 6 --interval 1s
# check agent log
grep "buffer drop" /var/log/agent.log
```

sam_ops: After reproducing, check ledger sequence vs audit log: 

sam_ops: ```bash
# compare last_seq numbers
cat /var/lib/meter/ledger | tail -n 20
meter-audit query --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-06 --filter cluster=vpc-nyc > audit.json
python tools/compare_sequences.py ledger audit.json
```

alex_support: Customer asked whether a manual replay will restore missing tokens to the billing ledger. What's safe?

maria_infra: If events were dropped at flush time (and not persisted), replay won't magically recreate them. But we saw cases where coalesced heartbeats were deduped early and later the seq pointer advanced while the per-heartbeat counters were omitted — in that case a replay of the agent buffer (if available) can restore counts.

maria_infra: Quick mitigation for customer: 1) upgrade to 1.4.5 which removes the buggy advance-on-error; 2) temporarily set `heartbeat_coalesce=false` and `buffer_flush_interval=1s` to reduce aggregation and flush delay; 3) run the audit/compare commands above and share outputs with support.

tony_support: Can we provide a script for the customer to run that collects the required artifacts? They want exact steps to avoid shipping logs with PII.

sam_ops: I'll draft a script. It will: collect agent version, last 10k lines of agent log, /var/lib/meter/ledger (sanitized), and run `meter-audit` with a limited time window. Output is zipped with checksums.

sam_ops: ```bash
# gather for support (sanitizes some fields)
sudo journalctl -u agent -n 10000 > agent-last.log
sudo cp /var/lib/meter/ledger ledger.raw
python tools/sanitize_ledger.py ledger.raw > ledger.sanitized
meter-audit query --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-06 --filter cluster=vpc-nyc > audit.json
zip support_bundle.zip agent-last.log ledger.sanitized audit.json
sha256sum support_bundle.zip > support_bundle.sha256
```

alex_support: Perfect. I'll send upgrade + mitigation instructions and ask them to run the bundle script. Also propose a provisional credit while we confirm root cause.

maria_infra: Agree. If they can reproduce in test with our repro steps we'll likely confirm the agent bug. For production cluster, advise to keep agent network attached and monitor `buffer_drop` metric.

metering-bot: Incident file created: MET-2026-0334 - "agent flush-failure + coalesce -> undercount" assigned to sam_ops.

tony_support: Thanks all — customer notified. I'll keep this thread updated with bundle and whether upgrade resolves it. :thumbsup:

alex_support: Closing loop for now; will reopen if bundle shows different. Thanks everyone."
